text:
dev-deploy-bot: RELEASE CHECK FAILED — env-parity-check blocked promotion. Problem: secret /prod/inference/kvcache encoding mismatch vs staging (key: inference-kv). Promotion paused.

alice: saw the bot. what exactly is mismatched?

ben: looks like staging stores the KV values as base64-encoded JSON, prod contains hex-encoded bytes. runtime expects base64 -> JSON parse. prod loads are 500s on startup.

carmen: confirmed. example: staging value starts with 'eyJpdiI' (base64), prod has '0a1b2c3d' style hex. I think a one-off migration years ago wrote hex to prod.

dave: this release pins model-serving image to v2.1.0 which relies on kv cache payload being base64 JSON. If we promote without fixing, runtime will crash on cache warmup for a subset of customers.

erin: options: rollback to previous image (v2.0.4), run a secret backfill (re-encode prod secrets to base64), or ship a runtime shim that accepts both encodings. Tradeoffs?

ben: shim is tempting but touches runtime parsing in a critical path — higher risk under prod traffic. Backfill is lower-risk but requires KMS decrypt/re-encrypt and a short write window. Rollback is fastest and safest but loses v2.1.0 improvements.

carmen: I can author a backfill job that runs in a job pod: decrypt using KMS, detect hex vs base64, convert hex->bytes->base64(JSON) and re-put secret. Need deploy permission and a 20m throttled maintenance window to avoid burst writes.

sre-oncall: we can schedule a 30m change window within the next 45m. We'll throttle SecretManager calls to avoid rate limits and watch for API errors. Approve if you want to proceed with backfill.

dave: alternative: create a canary pin PR to keep the release but pin canary traffic to v2.0.4 while backfill runs across prod. That buys time and is less user-impacting. If backfill finishes cleanly, we can flip canary to v2.1.0.

erin: I like canary pin + backfill. I'll own the backfill job. Carmen, can you own the secret conversion script and runbook? Dave, can you open the canary pin PR and coordinate the rollout?

carmen: yep. I already prototyped the script. snippet below (pseudo):
```bash
# run in prod maintenance namespace
kubectl run secret-backfill --image=gcr.io/redwood/secret-tools:latest --rm -it -- \
  --command -- /bin/sh -c "python backfill_kvcache.py --project prod --kms-key projects/..../keys/inference"
```
The script will log a dry-run first.

ben: note: we must add audit annotation with ticket #OPS-1192 and add a release-note line: 'Hotfix: secret kvcache encoding parity backfill, will enable v2.1.0'.

alice: timeline? we need to be inside the current change window or do immediate rollback. We're ~25m into the window. If we can land the pin PR + start the backfill within 15m, proceed. Otherwise rollback.

dave: opening PR now: branch 'pin-canary/v2.0.4-for-inference' -> target release branch. will request deploybot approval. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/4821 (draft)

erin: starting dry-run of conversion locally, will push image and playbook in 10m. Carmen, I'll hand exec to you for prod run.

carmen: after dry-run success, I'll run with --throttle=10r/s and monitor. Post-run we'll validate service logs and 200s on model load.

sre-oncall: I'll be on watch. Add me to the runbook channel and I'll escalate if error rates spike >2% for more than 5m.

ben: update release notes: add section under 'blocking fixes' and mark this as required for v2.1.0 promotion.

alice: agreed. If backfill fails we do immediate rollback. Who will trigger rollback? Dave?

dave: I will. Keep the rollback playbook ready: revert pin + promote old image.

erin: starting the dry run now, will report success/failure in this thread in ~8m.

[8m later]

erin: dry-run complete, conversion script good on sample subset. pushing image gcr.io/redwood/secret-tools:20240315-rc1.

carmen: executing prod backfill (throttled). running step 1 dry-run -> step 2 apply. watch logs here: https://logs.redwood/team/inference/backfill/3951234567

dev-deploy-bot: ACTION: canary pin PR merged for canary traffic (0.1%) to v2.0.4. Promotion to wider traffic paused until backfill completes.

ben: added OPS-1192 to changelog and release notes.

alice: thank you all. keep updates tight. postmortem + release note paragraph required after closure.

dev-deploy-bot: HOLD LIFTED: after verification, canary will be ramped to 100% -> v2.1.0 and hold removed. (final status to be posted after monitoring window).
